exposure: types II and III vasa previa
outcome: Successful occlusion of vasa previa vessels
Neonatal outcomes (transfusion, intraventricular hemorrhage, sepsis, patent ductus arteriosus, death)
cohort: 20 singleton pregnancies complicated by types II and III vasa previa treated with fetoscopic laser ablation at a gestational age ≥31 weeks at a single center between 2006 and 2022.
finding: Fetoscopic laser ablation for types II and III vasa previa at 31 to 33 gestational weeks was technically achievable and resulted in favorable outcomes.
mod_finding: 70% of the patients who underwent laser ablation for vasa previa delivered vaginally.
